summary.text: Caleb Walker, a Democratic U.S. Army combat veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 3rd Congressional District to Clay Higgins.
According to the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide, he was elected student body president at South Louisiana Community College.

paragraphs.text: According to the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide, Walker was elected student body president at South Louisiana Community College and serves on the state Task Force for Career Alignment.
He received 8.5% of the vote to Clay Higgins's 55.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
